descripcion:
JD Entregas es la app de los mensajeros de JD Logística para retirar y entregar guías aéreas.

Cada mensajero entra con su propio usuario y ve solo las guías que tiene asignadas: las que debe retirar en la aerolínea y las que debe entregar al cliente.

AL ENTREGAR UNA GUÍA
• Escanea el acta firmada con la cámara: la app encuentra la hoja, la recorta y la endereza, y junta varias páginas en un PDF.
• Escribe el nombre y la cédula de quien recibe.
• Toma la foto de la cédula de quien recibe.
• Guarda la fecha y la ubicación de la entrega.
• Si la guía se envía a Guayaquil, se registra en un toque.

TODO QUEDA EN EL SISTEMA AL INSTANTE
La oficina ve quién recibió, cuándo y dónde, con el acta en PDF, y el cliente lo ve en su portal de seguimiento.

FUNCIONA CON MALA SEÑAL
Las fotos se suben una por una y, si se corta el internet, no se pierden: se vuelve a intentar con un toque.

Uso exclusivo del personal de JD Logística (fletes, carga, importación y exportación). Se necesita un usuario entregado por la empresa.

Hecho en Ecuador por Tukán Software.
texto_promocional: La app de los mensajeros de JD Logística: escanea el acta firmada y registra cada entrega con cédula, fecha y ubicación.
notas_revisor:
1. Screen recording (physical iPhone, latest iOS): {video}

2. Purpose and audience: JD Entregas is the app for the couriers of JD Logística, a freight, air cargo, import and export company in Ecuador (same group as Tukán Software). Each courier sees only the air waybills (guías) assigned to him: those to pick up at the airline and those to deliver to the customer. Problem it solves: proof of delivery was kept on paper; now the signed delivery receipt, who received it, when and where are saved instantly and the customer sees them in a tracking portal.

3. How to use it: sign in with the demo account in the App Review Information section (a sample courier user with invented data). After login, the home screen lists the courier's assigned guías, split into those to pick up (retirar) and those to deliver (entregar). Open a guía and tap Entregar: scan the signed receipt (acta) with the camera (the app finds and straightens the page and joins several pages into one PDF), type the name and ID number of the person receiving, optionally photograph the recipient's ID card, and save. The delivery date and location are stored automatically. If the guía is sent to Guayaquil, it is registered with one tap. Photos upload one by one and can be retried with a tap if the signal drops. Accounts are created by JD Logística for its couriers; there is no self sign-up in the iOS app, and account deletion is handled on request (info@tukansoftware.com). On iPhone there are no prices, plans or payments for our software: it is an internal tool, not sold through the app. Customers do not log in to this app.

4. External services: the company's own server (sistema.jdlogistica.com); Cloudflare (hosting/CDN). Camera: scanning the delivery receipt and photographing the recipient's ID, only when the courier taps the button. Location: only at the moment of delivery, to record where the guía was delivered; no background tracking. No ads, no third-party analytics.

5. Regional differences: none. The app works the same in every region (Spanish).

6. Regulated industry / third-party material: not regulated. The recipient's name and ID number are collected only as proof of delivery, kept by the company, and shown to the customer who sent the shipment. Privacy policy: https://sistema.jdlogistica.com/privacidad.php.
